originality.rationale: A targeted claim-level comparison was made to a constant-affinity two-level battery, a pre-existing four-state telegraph-driven two-well Markov model, and general network entropy thermodynamics, plus semantic searches of related public mathematical results. The exact normalized storage/EPR frontier and its stationary curvature were not established by the inspected claims; however older four-state machinery is credited and broader theoretical subsumption is a serious residual priority risk, not ruled out merely by failed search.
residual_risks: The classic four-state telegraph master equation is so close that the precise complementarity may already exist as an unlocated corollary of general switched-generator solutions.
Searches cannot establish global scientific novelty; peer review of publication priority is outstanding.
The physical fuel expenditure of implementing random switching is not captured by the chain path entropy alone.

value.rationale: The exact zero-mean fluctuating-supply charge is a natural extension of a published active-matter battery: it shows positive but noninverted stationary storage, a complete switching-rate charge/EPR frontier, and a positive limiting hidden dissipation when the observed battery becomes thermal. These are precise motivated physical inferences rather than arbitrary parameter slices, although the underlying four-state algebra is elementary and should not be mistaken for a general theorem of active matter.
